data.gender_notes: Alphonsina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Alfonso, Alphonsina means 'noble' and 'ready for battle'. In Christian tradition, it is the name of several saints and blesseds, including Saint Alphonsa of India and Blessed Alphonsina López. It is also a popular name in Spanish-speaking countries. The name Alphonsina carries the meaning “Noble, ready for battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alphonsina usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, ready for battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and resilience in the face of adversity

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alphonsina total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
